chunks: Alas for the servants! No messenger came to them but they made fun of him.
ai.seo_question: Why did the people mock the prophets according to Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Yaseen is often cited to illustrate the psychological barrier of 'istikbar' (arrogance) that prevents the common people ('ibad') from recognizing truth, as seen in the rejection of the Ahl al-Bayt. It underscores the historical continuity of divine guidance being met with ridicule, a pattern that culminates in the Day of Judgment when regret becomes futile.
